content:
maya: Noticed discrepancy: console shows confirmed tokens low for a customer doing streaming + toolcalls after reconnects. Example acct: blue-orca. Anyone seen similar?

jon: Yep, appears when a toolcall is truncated on reconnect and the finalize/commit event never arrives. Billing only counts commits so UI underreports.

ria: Can we get a tiny trace?

maya: Paste: 
```
START session=sess42
CHUNK tokens=600
TOOLCALL start id=tc1
TOOLCALL truncated id=tc1 tokens=0
RECONNECT session=sess42
CHUNK tokens=900
# no FINALIZE seen
```
Result: console shows ~1.5k tokens but actual was ~3k.

jon: Two causes: missing finalize + aggressive sampling of chunk events.

ria: Short-term: add "provisional_estimate" column in console and a workspace toggle to include provisional in quota checks for debugging. Long-term: add idempotent finalize_session RPC (session_id, token_count, seq_hash). Ledger dedupes by seq_hash so finalize can be retried safely.

maya: Also propose a lightweight chunk_ack path for near-real-time tallies (1% pilot) to measure write cost.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary for chunk_ack pilot at 01:00 UTC, traffic=1%.

jon: Add router metric missing_finalize_rate and alert if finalize < 95% of session ends for 5m.

ria: Filed ISSUE-3112 for finalize RPC + UI mockups. Will follow up after canary.
